sourceHandlingPolicy.acceptedInput: Lawfully acquired PDF or EPUB supplied privately by the user.
sourceHandlingPolicy.repositoryRule: Never commit copyrighted source files. Commit only bibliographic metadata, hashes, neutral non-substitutive paraphrases, exact chapter/page locators, and review status.
sourceHandlingPolicy.rightsRule: Private lawful access can support internal fidelity review. It does not automatically grant public redistribution or publication rights.
sourceHandlingPolicy.reasoningRule: Do not reconstruct private chain of thought. Produce auditable Framework Cards and seven-part Decision Traces.
